```{=html}
<div id="map-jul28" class="day-map"></div>
<script>
(function() {
  var map = L.map('map-jul28').setView([37.5300, 126.9900], 12);
  L.tileLayer('https://{s}.tile.openstreetmap.org/{z}/{x}/{y}.png', {
    attribution: '© <a href="https://www.openstreetmap.org/copyright">OSM</a>'
  }).addTo(map);
  function dot(c) {
    return L.divIcon({ className:'', html:'<div style="width:13px;height:13px;border-radius:50%;background:'+c+';border:2.5px solid #fff;box-shadow:0 1px 5px rgba(0,0,0,.4)"></div>', iconSize:[13,13], iconAnchor:[6,6], popupAnchor:[0,-8] });
  }
  function hotelDot() {
    return L.divIcon({ className:'', html:'<div style="width:22px;height:22px;border-radius:50%;background:#4A148C;border:2.5px solid #fff;box-shadow:0 2px 6px rgba(0,0,0,.5);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-size:12px;line-height:1;color:#fff">★</div>', iconSize:[22,22], iconAnchor:[11,11], popupAnchor:[0,-13] });
  }
  var pts = [
    { name:'🏨 Shilla Stay Seodaemun Seoul Station', lat:37.5572, lng:126.9680, hotel:true, url:'https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=Shilla+Stay+Seodaemun+Seoul+Station' },
    { name:'VIC Lab Color Analysis 🎨 (Booked)', lat:37.5585, lng:126.9209, c:'#C62828', url:'https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=15+World+Cup+buk-ro+4-gil' },
    { name:'Mangwon Market 🍜', lat:37.5551, lng:126.9046, c:'#43A047', url:'https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=Mangwon+Market+Seoul', hours:'9:00 AM – 9:00 PM' },
    { name:'Tamburins Flagship 🧴',lat:37.5209, lng:127.0221, c:'#00897B', url:'https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=Tamburins+flagship+Sinsa+Seoul' },
    { name:'Hair Tattoo Appointment 💇', lat:37.5220, lng:127.0279, c:'#C62828', url:'https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=hair+tattoo+salon+Gangnam+Seoul' },
    { name:'Gebang Sikdang 🦀 (Soy Crab)', lat:37.51764326285173, lng:127.03941658573348, c:'#43A047', url:'https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=Gebang+Sikdang+Seoul', hours:'11:30–21:00 (break 15:00–17:30)' },
    { name:'Sappun Shoes 👟', lat:37.5203, lng:127.0225, c:'#EC407A', url:'https://share.google/1W5iNuG4JvJBuEQan' },
    { name: 'Blue Elephant', lat:37.5252, lng:127.03661, c:'#EC407A', url:'https://maps.app.goo.gl/CrmhGn5exhUnqFXo7'},
    { name: 'Rockfish Weatherwear Dosan', lat:37.5254, lng:127.0373, c:'#EC407A', url:'https://maps.app.goo.gl/Zw6ppFTFKxw6nPtx8'},
    { name: 'Osoi', lat:37.5465, lng:127.05104, c:'#EC407A', url: 'https://maps.app.goo.gl/Yr9idjP7AJjC1CnS6'},
    { name: 'DOUBLE LOVERS SEONGSU FLAGSHIP STORE', lat:37.5437, lng:127.0548, c:'#ec40aa', url: 'https://maps.app.goo.gl/YzPU8Qo1fnScC3Rk7'},
    { name: 'MARGESHERWOOD Seoul Flagship Store', lat:37.5435, lng:127.0572, c:'#ec40aa', url: 'https://maps.app.goo.gl/M6kusS5gXj8dnZQz6'},
    { name: 'STAND OIL', lat:37.54398875947829, lng:127.05746441492252, c:'#ec40aa', url: 'https://maps.app.goo.gl/xS5Hjpgqxg6qB4dY8'},
    { name: 'Muguok 🍗 (Samgyetang)', lat:37.57655560914056, lng:126.97995930859655, c:'#43A047', url: 'https://maps.app.goo.gl/qdP7xa4t58aPvJHq5'},
  ];
  window.pageMap = map; window.pageMarkers = [];
  pts.forEach(function(p) {
    var m = L.marker([p.lat, p.lng], { icon: p.hotel ? hotelDot() : dot(p.c) }).addTo(map);
    var html = '<b>' + p.name + '</b>';
    if (p.hours) html += '<br><span style="font-size:12px">🕐 ' + p.hours + '</span>';
    if (p.url) html += '<br><a href="' + p.url + '" target="_blank" style="font-size:12px">Open in Maps →</a>';
    m.bindPopup(html);
    window.pageMarkers.push({ marker: m, lat: p.lat, lng: p.lng });
  });
  function routeLabel(n, color) {
    return L.divIcon({ className:'', html:'<div style="width:18px;height:18px;border-radius:50%;background:'+color+';border:2px solid #fff;box-shadow:0 1px 4px rgba(0,0,0,.4);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-size:11px;font-weight:700;color:#fff;line-height:1">'+n+'</div>', iconSize:[18,18], iconAnchor:[9,9] });
  }
  // Route 1: Shilla Stay → VIC Lab
  L.polyline([[37.5572,126.9680],[37.5585,126.9209]], { color:'#4A148C', weight:3, dashArray:'6,5', opacity:0.7 }).addTo(map);
  L.marker([37.5579,126.9445], { icon:routeLabel(1,'#4A148C') }).addTo(map);
  // Route 2: VIC Lab → Mangwon Market
  L.polyline([[37.5585,126.9209],[37.5551,126.9046]], { color:'#1565C0', weight:3, dashArray:'6,5', opacity:0.7 }).addTo(map);
  L.marker([37.5568,126.9128], { icon:routeLabel(2,'#1565C0') }).addTo(map);
  // Route 3: Mangwon Market → Muguok
  L.polyline([[37.5551,126.9046],[37.5766,126.9800]], { color:'#00897B', weight:3, dashArray:'6,5', opacity:0.7 }).addTo(map);
  L.marker([37.5658,126.9423], { icon:routeLabel(3,'#00897B') }).addTo(map);
  // Route 4: Muguok → Seongsu cluster (Osoi / Double Lovers / MARGESHERWOOD / STAND OIL)
  L.polyline([[37.5766,126.9800],[37.5440,127.0550]], { color:'#E65100', weight:3, dashArray:'6,5', opacity:0.7 }).addTo(map);
  L.marker([37.5603,127.0175], { icon:routeLabel(4,'#E65100') }).addTo(map);
  // Route 5: Seongsu cluster → Sinsa / Garosugil (transit)
  L.polyline([[37.5440,127.0550],[37.5209,127.0221]], { color:'#6A1B9A', weight:3, dashArray:'6,5', opacity:0.7 }).addTo(map);
  L.marker([37.5325,127.0386], { icon:routeLabel(5,'#6A1B9A') }).addTo(map);
  // Route 6: Sinsa / Garosugil → Gebang Sikdang
  L.polyline([[37.5209,127.0221],[37.5176,127.0394]], { color:'#B71C1C', weight:3, dashArray:'6,5', opacity:0.7 }).addTo(map);
  L.marker([37.5193,127.0308], { icon:routeLabel(6,'#B71C1C') }).addTo(map);
})();
</script>
```
